_about: One shared source for a job card's status list, priority list, which statuses count as settled/finished, and the worker manual-status-change rule. The server reads this file directly; the client imports it too (see vite.config.js's server.fs.allow, and the re-exports in client/src/components/jobcard/constants.js and client/src/components/JobCardList.constants.js). JSON can't hold comments, so the reasoning for each list lives as a comment at each import site instead of here.
